title: T44 — Associative Learning Between Assemblies
rationale: T43C validated creation, reinforcement and recall of assemblies, but no associative learning between distinct assemblies exists yet. This limits the transition from isolated episodic-semantic memory to relational memory.
implementation_plan: 3. Link assemblies when co-activated within temporal window
5. Add associative recall: cue assembly A → retrieve assembly B
safety_constraints: No modification of core CellAssembly models
Association store must be separable from assembly store
Energy injection bounded during associative recall
